<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 - H)/2 (oxygen does not affect the calculation). For C9H7O4: DBE = (2*9 + 2 - 7) / 2 = (18 + 2 - 7) / 2 = 13 / 2 = 6.5. Since DBE must be an integer for a neutral molecule, the intended formula likely corresponds to DBE = 6.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
